newsitem.title: UK: Bank of England signals no change in rates.
newsitem.headline: Bank of England signals no change in rates.

text.p: The Bank of England signalled that it had left official interest rates unchanged at 6.0 percent after Wednesday's monetary policy meeting by offering the money market routine assistance in the early round of operations.
It made no announcement about a new minimum lending rate, the method by which it normally signals a rate change.

The Bank invited money market operators to offer band 1 and 2 bills and offered an unrestricted bill/FRG repo to February 21 to help alleviate a liquidity shortage which it forecast at 1.2 billion stg.
